message:
How it reads now:
Purchases sheet
What (text, required), Team (Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Operations or People), Requested by (person, whoever adds it), Date (date, today), Supplier (text).
Steps: Submitted → Approved → Ordered → Received or Rejected.
Approved: not by the person who asked
Rejected: not by the person who asked

Purchase lines sheet
Item (text, required), Quantity (number, required), Unit price (money, required).

Expenses sheet
What for (text, required), Who (person, required, whoever adds it), Date (date, required), Amount (money, required), Category (Meals, Travel, Software, Cloud, Office or Other), Paid with (My own card or Company card), Receipt (file), Paid on (date), Note (text).
The form: Basics (What for, Who, Date, Amount, Category and Note), Payment (Paid with, Receipt and Paid on). Asked when creating: What for, Who, Date, Amount and Receipt.
Steps: Needs a receipt → Submitted → Approved → Paid or Rejected.
Needs a receipt: only the person who asked moves it on
Approved: not by the person who asked
Rejected: not by the person who asked

What happens by itself
An expense added with its receipt is Submitted.
When a receipt is attached to an expense that needs one, it is Submitted.
Submitted expenses wait on Lena to approve them.
An expense without a category: an AI step suggests one, Lena confirms.

Who can see and do what
Lena Ortiz and Wade Wilson see every purchase, add, edit and move them, and change how it works.
Everyone sees their own purchases and expenses and can add, edit and move them.
Krishna sees every purchase, move them.

Connections
People fills Requested by.
People fills Who.

Coming soon
Connections to other software

Latest message from Wade Wilson:
Keep spending limits for each category, each with the date it starts. An expense can't be over its category's limit in force on its date.
